cohort: MER-Caption+ training only; previous 32 plus fixed random additional 96

metrics.whole: Per-answer-token CE including label sentence, separators, ### and EOS
metrics.emotion: CE restricted to tokens intersecting raw openset label character spans in the original complete target tokenization
metrics.scaffolding: Non-label sentence prefix and label separators
metrics.first_emotion_js: Jensen-Shannon divergence of full-vocabulary distributions at the first emotion token under teacher forcing; not full free generation

bootstrap.unit: Recipient after averaging five donor effects
bootstrap.caveat: Exploratory intervals conditional on frozen checkpoints and donor maps; shared donors and training-seed uncertainty are not modeled

validation.bootstrap_caveat: Exploratory intervals conditional on frozen checkpoints and donor maps; shared donors and training-seed uncertainty are not modeled

interpretation: Mean audio correct-label sensitivity is lower in the native version, but paired whole-answer and emotion-token NLL intervals include zero.
First-emotion distribution response to audio swaps is lower in all five donor permutations. A response difference is not a proven accuracy regression.
Video distribution response is also lower although its mean correct-label loss penalty is larger; sensitivity and usefulness are distinct.
Input norm differences largely disappear after first-layer normalization; residual and later-layer scale effects remain untested.
Temporal centered energy and representation diversity do not measure emotion information or identify a unique cause.

next_candidate.hypothesis: Whole-sequence audio averaging may discard useful temporal variation; retaining four ordered segment means may improve use of audio.
next_candidate.control: native_av_mean with one independent audio token
next_candidate.single_changed_factor: Independent audio temporal granularity: one global mean token to up to four ordered segment-mean tokens

pooling.input: All unpadded native audio encoder positions, before frontend truncation
pooling.partition: Contiguous nonempty chunks in chronological order, sizes differ by at most one; use min(4,T) chunks for T positions
pooling.projection: Reuse the same bias-free audio_native_in 2048->256 and audio_in 256->2048 on every chunk

held_fixed: Complete raw subtitle and question wording
One independent global-mean video token and its existing projection
Original fusion frontend architecture and calibration
Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and identical shared initialization at seed 42
31,327 training examples once, CE only, batch 1, accumulation 3, 10,443 optimizer steps
Training data order, task sampling and learning-rate schedule
required_before_training: Implement audio token-sequence assembly and explicit checkpoint/config compatibility guards
Verify the one-token configuration reproduces current initialization, loss and generation
Verify no parameter or shared-RNG change; verify nonempty segment bounds including T<4
Recheck full training prompt/target lengths with up to three additional prompt positions; no silent truncation or sample dropping
Real 3B forward/backward/generation smoke checks; finite gradients through shared audio projection and fusion
Register final configuration, source fingerprints, validation criteria and fixed final-checkpoint evaluation before training
next_candidate.training_start: Fresh pretrained base, not continuation from the one-token final checkpoint
next_candidate.diagnostic_comparison: Reuse the same 128 training rows and five donor maps; compare whole-answer and emotion-token NLL, first-emotion distribution response, and their uncertainty. Greater sensitivity alone is not better accuracy.
next_candidate.benchmark_policy: MER2024 stays deferred; no benchmark sweep or checkpoint selection. Any later benchmark reporting uses the predeclared final checkpoint once.
limits: Current paired audio NLL differences include zero in exploratory intervals, so no proven audio-accuracy regression
First-layer normalization largely equalizes input norms, but residual-stream and later-layer scale effects remain possible
Temporal variation energy is not an estimate of emotion information
Four audio tokens also lengthen the prompt and expose ordering; this tests audio temporal granularity, not padding alone or pure order retention
